scope: Curated GX first wave, 14 GX cards plus two DM support cards; not a complete era or OCG implementation.
catalogAndArt: YGOPRODeck public cardinfo API; per-file URLs, hashes and unresolved IP status in asset-rights.json.
limits: Only named-material fusion recipes and existing small-pool effects supported.
Fusion and ritual choices occur at activation and are atomically revalidated at resolution, unlike full OCG resolution-time selection.
Existing simplified damage-step / attack-replay handling retained. No contact fusion or full Neos support.
Two presets are beginner templates, not competitively calibrated decks.
